defs.def: a thing that is used for transporting people or goods from one place to another, such as a car or lorry/truck 交通工具；车辆

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想把车停在朋友附近的人，所有车辆必须持有同一区域的停车证并同时到达——车位不能预留。

ex.s: After a struggle, she managed to free the vehicle and continued inching along the snow-covered road.
ex.t: 经过一番努力，她设法把车弄了出来，继续在积雪覆盖的道路上缓慢前行。

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那整合了一整套清洁能源技术，帮助公共交通变得更加环保，同时也为应对气候变化尽一份力，并助力欧洲向私人电动汽车市场的艰难转型。

ex.s: 21 What percentage of global transport emissions did road vehicles account for in 2018?
ex.t: 21 2018年道路车辆占全球交通排放的百分比是多少？

ex.s: From the vehicle of horses to today's convenient transport, Chinese transport has an enormous development.
ex.t: 从马车到如今便捷的交通，中国交通取得了巨大的发展。

ex.s: If you can start the conversation with a question other than “What do you do for a living?", you'll be able to get a lot more interesting conversation out of whomever it is you're talking to. ____37 ___. it can bring in "I have this old, broken-down vehicle" or "I rode the bus with these crazy people who were laughing at silly jokes in the back." It just opens up conversation.
ex.t: 如果你能用一个“你是做什么工作的？”以外的问题开启对话，你就能和交谈对象聊出更有趣的内容。___37___。它能引出“我有一辆破旧抛锚的车”之类的话。

ex.t: 它的路面被车辆损坏了。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者都必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在历史上提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或飞往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式影响着人们的生活。

ex.s: Some students don't have a reliable car, while others have to   27   vehicles with parents who work six days a week.
ex.t: 一些学生没有可靠的汽车，而另一些学生则不得不27（share/共用）车辆，与一周工作六天的父母共用。

ex.s: The California Department of Motor Vehicles began giving permits in April for companies to test truly self-driving cars on public roads.
ex.t: 加州机动车管理局于4月开始发放许可，允许企业在公共道路上测试真正的自动驾驶汽车。

ex.s: Companies have been testing their vehicles in cities across the country.
ex.t: 未来的汽车即将到来。

ex.s: The arrival of driverless vehicles is a chance to make sure that those vehicles are environmentally friendly and more shared.
ex.t: 帮助解决交通相关问题

ex.s: Imagine a future where most adults own individual self-driving vehicles.
ex.t: 对我们的环境造成损害

ex.s: They take their driverless car to an appointment and set the empty vehicle to circle the building to avoid paying for parking.
ex.t: 他们开着无人驾驶汽车赴约，并让空车绕着大楼转圈，以避免支付停车费。

ex.s: Policymakers should start thinking now about how to make sure the appearance of driverless vehicles doesn’t extend the worst aspects of the car-controlled transportation system we have today.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在就应该开始思考，如何确保无人驾驶汽车的出现不会延续当今这种以汽车为主导的交通体系中最糟糕的方面。

ex.s: The vehicle — named the Transition – has two seats, four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.
ex.t: 这款名为"Transition"的车辆有两个座位、四个车轮，机翼可以折叠起来，因此可以像汽车一样驾驶。

ex.s: The govemment has already permitted the company to use special materials to make it easier for the vehicle to fly.
ex.t: 政府已经允许该公司使用特殊材料，使这款车辆更容易飞行。

ex.s: Mac heard a large vehicle behind him.
ex.t: 麦克听到身后有一辆大型车辆的声音。

ex.s: The government has already permitted the company to use special materials to make it easier for the vehicle to fly.
ex.t: 政府已经允许该公司使用特殊材料，使这辆飞行器更容易飞行。

ex.s: And set-ups such as bike and car sharing do a further favour for the environment by reducing the number of polluting vehicles on the road.
ex.t: 而共享单车、共享汽车之类的模式，通过减少路上污染车辆的数量，进一步造福环境。

defs.def: something that can be used to express your ideas or feelings or as a way of achieving sth （赖以表达思想、感情或达到目的的）手段，工具

ex.s: We started from Vancouver, where we picked up our vehicle for the trip - a home on wheels.
ex.t: 我们从温哥华出发，在那里取了旅行用的车——一辆房车。

ex.s: Now, reduced energy supplies and environmental pollution have led to more advances in the technology of new energy vehicles.
ex.t: 如今，能源供应减少和环境污染推动了新能源汽车技术的进一步发展。

ex.s: Suddenly the cart turned over and the man was thrown across it – in no time at all small fragments of the vehicle were violently thrown along the street.
ex.t: 突然马车翻倒，那人被甩了出去——转眼间，车的碎片被猛地抛飞，沿街散落。

ex.s: Today, scientists design vehicles to carry astronauts into space to make important discoveries.
ex.t: 如今，科学家设计飞行器把宇航员送入太空，以做出重大发现。
